specs.aspecto: 9:16 recommended; since June 2025 every Facebook video is a reel, any length or orientation
specs.max_nota: No length cap for reels since the June 2025 change (Meta: from a 30-second vertical clip to a 20-minute-plus horizontal episode). Rolled out over the following months.
specs.ideal_nota: Heuristic (no Meta figure). Facebook's audience skews older and tolerates longer explanations; 60-90 s works for an educational episode (unverified).

safe_area.nota: unverified: same Meta Stories/Reels ad safe-zone reading as Instagram (top 14%, bottom 35%, sides 6%).

caption_limit.nota: unverified (long-standing Facebook post limit). Only the first line or two show; write it like the Instagram first line.

specs.cover: Frame or uploaded thumbnail; same centred-text rule as Instagram.

algoritmo: Meta says the 2025 'all videos are reels' change does not change which videos are recommended; recommendations stay personalised by interests.

Facebook demotes engagement bait: posts, comments and videos (including in the audio) that push likes, shares, comments or votes to boost reach ('LIKE this if...'); Pages that repeat it get Page-level demotion. Posts that ask for help, advice or recommendations are not affected.

Shared Meta signals apply (watch time, shares/sends, originality, watermark and low-quality demotions) per Instagram's explainer; Facebook-specific ranking documents not re-checked this session (unverified).
estrategia: Cross-post from Instagram (Accounts Center) or upload natively; native upload lets you set a Facebook-specific caption.
Phrase the closing question as a genuine opinion request, never as 'comment A or B' vote bait (spoken bait is detected too).
Longer 'story' cuts (90-180 s) of the same episode can work here because there is no cap; test one.
cta: 'Which one would you hang at home, and why?' (opinion, not vote bait).
Follow the Page for the series.
Share to a group about art or history (share prompt framed as usefulness).

hashtags_seo.caption: Hook line + 1-2 sentences; 1-3 hashtags at most (low value on Facebook, unverified).
hashtags_seo.busqueda: Facebook search reads captions; names and places in plain text.

musica: Same Meta music licensing as Instagram (personal vs business accounts; Meta Sound Collection for commercial use). Own/generated music is the safe default.

ia_disclosure.obligatorio: Same Meta policy as Instagram: disclose photorealistic video or realistic-sounding audio that was digitally created or altered.
ia_disclosure.como: AI label toggle when posting; 'AI info' auto-label from industry signals (C2PA/IPTC).
ia_disclosure.consecuencias: Meta 'may apply penalties'; altered content rated by fact-checkers is shown lower.
ia_disclosure.para_esta_app: Always toggle the AI label for the photoreal presenter.

publicacion.cadencia: No official figure. 3-5 per week for a series when cross-posting from Instagram (unverified heuristic).
publicacion.horas: Meta Business Suite insights for the Page's audience activity.

adaptar_desde_master: Same file as Instagram (9:16, no watermarks, subtitles above y=1250).
Rewrite the closing CTA as an opinion request; remove any 'comment/like/share if' line from the voice-over if one exists.
